title: Federation listener preface-drop diagnostic writes with eprintln! inside the accept loop (can block, panic, or flood)
outcome: The listener's diagnostic for a connection dropped before its preface cannot stall, panic or flood the accept loop.
acceptance: The preface-drop diagnostic in FederationSocketListener::accept is written through a path that cannot panic when stderr is unwritable and does not block the accept loop on a slow stderr sink.
Repeated immediate preface read failures from a peer are rate-limited or aggregated so they cannot flood the log, and the outcome name and peer address stay visible for at least the first occurrence.
A behaviour test drives repeated preface failures and shows the accept loop keeps admitting connections, with no wall-clock thresholds and no retries.
